title: Institute of Health button
description: A wide, flat rectangle with 4px corners: the label sits top-left and a small corner-down-right arrow bottom-right. Dark (ink fill), light (page-grey fill) and glass (translucent white with a 45% white border, for media) variants. On hover the 2px border fades to a mid grey over 0.45s.
notes: glass is meant for dark media backdrops; it uses highlight-foreground for its text and border
